_what: AA Intelligence Index against USD cost to run that index once -- the two axes of AA's published intelligence-vs-cost chart, harvested so we can place our own fleet on it.
_x_axis: costPerTask = intelligenceIndexCostPerTask.cost.total, USD. Sum of the per-evaluation weightedCostPerTask values. OVERWHELMINGLY INPUT TOKENS (for Qwen3.8 27B, $2.40 of $2.49), so it is not comparable to a generation-only rate.
_basis_note: intelligenceIndexIsEstimated is AA's OWN flag, kept verbatim. An estimated score is not a measurement and must not be plotted or ranked as one. Every record that carries a cost is measured; the estimates are all cost-free, which is why a cost-bearing subset is also the plottable subset.
_why_not_the_evaluations_page: The /evaluations/ page that renders the published chart loads its data over an API and embeds only 30 records with no cost field. Model pages ship the full payload.
